QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Piece of Mind of Maple
QuestInfo.0: #bChief Stan#k knows about your quest for the #rMind of Maple#k. He is awaiting your arrival, so go prove your worth to him.
QuestInfo.1:
Follow the instructions #bChief Stan#k, and defeat the monsters to gather up the appropriate items and prove him your worth.

QuestInfo.2: You have finally received an item of approval from Chief Stan. What does this have to do with restoring #rMind of Maple#k?

0.0: Are you here, traveler? I have been waiting for you. I have heard much about you through Cody. I have a test for you that will prove your worth. I want you to gather up 5 types of maple pieces by hunting monsters around town. Are you up for it?
0.1: #rPiece of Courage#k is dropped by #bWild Boars, Dark Axe Stumps, and Axe Stumps#k.
0.2: #rPiece of Wisdom#k is dropped by #bOrange Mushrooms, Pigs, and Ribbon Pigs#k.
0.3: #rPiece of Accuracy#k is dropped by #bOctopus', Blue Mushrooms, and Bubblings#k.
0.4: #rPiece of Dexterity#k is dropped by #bGreen Mushrooms, Slimes, and Lupins#k.
0.5: #rPiece of Freedom#k is dropped by #bEvil Eyes, Curse Eyes, and Jr. Neckis#k.
0.6: I wish you the best of luck.

yes.0: I will be here watching you work. Remember, you do not have much time. I advise you to take care of this quickly.

no.0: Are you not ready yet? If you want to prove your worth to me, then you should taken on this mission. Trust your abilities.

yes.0: I knew you wouldn't disappoint. The reason I have asked you to gather these up is not only to test your abilities, but because these pieces are required to create something special. Now wait as I make the pendant for the 'Mind of Maple.'
yes.1: Now that I know you can pull your weight, here it is; an item of approval from me.

item.1: Piece of Courage is dropped by Wild Boars, Dark Axe Stumps, and Axe Stumps.
item.2: Piece of Wisdom is dropped by Orange Mushrooms, Pigs, and Ribbon Pigs.
item.3: Piece of Accuracy is dropped by Octopus', Blue Mushrooms, and Bubblings.
item.4: Piece of Dexterity is dropped by Green Mushrooms, Slimes, and Lupins.
item.5: Piece of Freedom is dropped by Evil Eyes, Curse Eyes, and Jr. Neckis.
